# Edelweiss Tavern

> Neighborhood sports and dive bar in Avondale, Chicago with pool, karaoke, pool leagues and daily specials. Rated 4.5 from 181 Google reviews.

- Type: Sports Bar
- Address: 3808 W Belmont Ave, Chicago, IL 60618, USA

## About
Edelweiss Tavern is a local sports and dive bar off Milwaukee and Belmont Ave. in Chicago, tucked between Hamlin Ave and Avers Ave in Avondale. We run a full bar with top shelf liquors and daily specials, plus pool, karaoke, a juke box and in-house pool leagues.
One reviewer called it low key, the kind of place that "feels like old time chicago." Another said they came in for a drink and stayed all night. We're rated 4.5 on Google from 181 reviews, and we'd love to see you on the next one.

## Services
- Karaoke: Karaoke every Friday and Saturday night until close, pulled from the DJ's own song collection.
- Billiards: Free billiards every Sunday and Monday.
- Pool Leagues: We offer in-house pool leagues, affiliated with the APA. Give us a call for more info.
- Birthday Special: Come in during your birthday month with 5 or more friends and the birthday guest drinks free.
- PBR bottles: One of our daily specials. ($2.00)

## FAQ
Q: Do you serve food?
A: No. One reviewer said it straight: no food here, but drinks and billiards.

Q: Where exactly are you?
A: On W Belmont Ave., between Hamlin Ave and Avers Ave in Avondale.

Q: How big is the karaoke song list?
A: The DJ brings an original collection of over 100,000 songs.

Q: How do I join a pool league?
A: Call us at (773) 293-7707 for more info on our in-house leagues.

## What customers say
- "Edelweiss is a pure gem and is THE best bar in Chicago. Laid back, friendly and a timeless classic former shift bar that now hosts a good mix of lively people. I’ve met one of my best friends in the city at this bar, spent birthdays, happy and sad moments here and the staff is just phenomenal. Olga is my favorite bartender in Chicago who has an incredible heart and makes you feel at home. Alex, who handles the karaoke machine is the best to sing your heart out with. I always bring out of town visitors, friends and loved ones here all the time, and is my space in the city. Businesses like this are the real soul of this city and in hard times and good times alike, they keep the city going…Have a Lvivske blonde and a Zubrowka in the front where you can mingle and sing, play billiards in the back, and have your intimate conversations in the really nice patio ;)" (Alexander Guerrero, 5/5)
- "NO FOOD HERE! But drinks! And billiards!

Come here to get a beer and play some pool and enjoy good company with your people. This is a beautiful hidden lil gem that is perfect for those people who are going to Warlord and have to wait for a table. Don’t go anywhere else. Just walk down the block and support this spot." (Nat, 5/5)
- "Great bar.

I stopped here with a friend because it was in between us. I figured it would be a traditional Chicago dive bar and it was but in all the good ways. The bartender was super nice, the prices were very reasonable, and they have a pool table!

Im gonna end up coming back to this place and I recommend it." (John Reed, 5/5)
- "Oksana and Sergei are very kind owners, that enjoy when their guests are having a good time. Olga and Jonah are fantastic bartenders! Speedy and love to chat!" (James Lewandowski, 5/5)
